杨童听了胡九郎的话，流露出一丝不耐烦的神情，看了一眼手腕上的手表。

“局长马上就要来了，你这个回答局长可不会满意的！”

胡九郎丝毫不惧。

“他是你们的局长，又不是我的局长，我可不怕他！”

杨童突然像是想起了什么。

“你若是不答应帮我们的话，那么莫奇卫给你的朱砂需没收，因为那属于赃物！除此之外，你还要为这件事负责！莫奇卫打伤我们的人，都得算你一份！”

胡九郎还未说话，阡陌忍不住说道：

“你们是正规部门吗？怎么还威胁人呢？”

杨童淡然道：

“我有没有威胁你，胡先生是最为清楚的！”

胡九郎耸了耸肩。

“你若是非要没收那个朱砂，我也无可奈何，至于让我负责，呵呵，你们749局虽然是特殊部门，但是也不能这般无法无天吧？我还真的不信你会这么做！”

杨童看样子似乎有些心急，妙目流转，紧接着似乎是想起来什么。

“你如果帮我们去一趟夜月村，那么我可以给你这个！”

杨童拿出一张空白符纸，这符纸黄黄的，看起来非常的干净，隐隐中有流波游走，这是上佳符纸，堪称可遇不可求。

“那么好的朱砂，如果不配更好的符纸，岂非是浪费了？”

由纯朱砂配这种符纸，符篆符咒的威力会更大，胡九郎此间高手，如何不知？

“你有多少？”

杨童微笑道：

“管够！”

胡九郎将符纸拿在手中，仔细端详。

“我只管带路，破阵法，不会再做其他事，我下山的时候，师父可是一再嘱咐，不要过多的干涉别人的因果之中！”

杨童点了点头。

“嗯，能理解，那就这么说定了，今天晚上，我们再去夜月村！”

杨童的话音刚落，一个中年人走了进来，约莫四五十岁，已然成为秃头，头上就剩下几根头发倔强的四下分开，看起来多少有点滑稽。

但是他眉目间却颇具威严，干咳一声，不怒自威。

“我是749局魔都分局局长余元山！你就是胡九郎对吧？我们这里没有你太多的资料，因为你不是异能者，但是你的能力我们是很清楚的！”

After hearing Hu Jiulang's words, Yang Tong showed a hint of impatience and glanced at the watch on his wrist.

"The director will be here soon. The director will not be satisfied with your answer!"

Hu Jiulang was not afraid at all.

"He is your director, not mine. I am not afraid of him!"

Yang Tong suddenly seemed to remember something.

"If you don't agree to help us, then the cinnabar Moqiwei gave you needs to be confiscated, because it is stolen goods! In addition, you have to be responsible for this! Anyone who Moqiwei hurts our people will be counted on you!"

Before Hu Jiulang spoke, Qian Mo couldn't help but said:

"Are you a regular department? Why are you still threatening people?"

Yang Tong said calmly:

"Mr. Hu knows best whether I have threatened you or not!"

Hu Jiulang shrugged.

"If you insist on confiscating that cinnabar, I have nothing to do. As for letting me take responsibility, haha, although your 749th Bureau is a special department, you can't be so lawless, right? I really don't believe you will do this!"

Yang Tong seemed a little anxious, his eyes were wandering, and then he seemed to think of something.

"If you help us go to Yeyue Village, then I can give you this!"

Yang Tong took out a blank piece of talisman paper. This talisman paper was yellow and looked very clean. There were faint waves moving around. This was the best talisman paper, which could only be found once in a while.

"Such good cinnabar, if it doesn't deserve better talismans, isn't it a waste?"

If pure cinnabar is used with this kind of talisman paper, the power of the talisman and seal talisman will be even greater. How could Hu Jiulang, a master here, not know?

"How many do you have?"

Yang Tong smiled and said:

"Enough!"

Hu Jiulang took the talisman paper in his hand and looked at it carefully.

"I only lead the way and break the formation. I won't do anything else. When I came down the mountain, Master repeatedly told me not to interfere too much in other people's cause and effect!"

Yang Tong nodded.

"Well, I understand, then it's settled. Let's go to Yeyue Village again tonight!"

As soon as Yang Tong finished speaking, a middle-aged man walked in. He was about forty or fifty years old. He was already bald. There were only a few hairs left on his head that were stubbornly parted in all directions. He looked a little funny.

However, his eyes were quite majestic, and he coughed dryly, showing his dignity without anger.

"I am Yu Yuanshan, director of the 749th Bureau's Magic City Branch! You are Hu Jiulang, right? We don't have much information about you here because you are not a superpower, but we know your abilities very well!"
